description: Renders a page of the preview in a real browser and returns the image plus any console errors. Use it to check your work visually, at mobile size too. Pages are rendered by Xodia's headless browser within a monthly allowance. When it answers that screenshots aren't available, or that it needs the project open in Xodia, don't call it again in this task: ask the user to look in Xodia and check with run_check and get_logs instead. headless_busy means try once more in about 30 seconds.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page height (up to 6000px). The page is not scrolled, so sections with scroll reveals below the first screen show in their start state (faded or hidden); that is expected. Capture a route with the section's anchor (/#pricing) to see them revealed.
